name: AXM Evidence Chain Application Drill Runner
actions: validate an unexpired evidence-chain application plan against exact source and candidate bytes
create one brand-new owned sandbox root with a fixed safe name prefix
write source, safety-copy, and staged candidate fixtures inside that root
simulate atomic application, independently inspect the result, and roll back exact bytes
delete the complete owned sandbox and emit a digest-only drill receipt
summary: Runs an actual apply, inspection, rollback, and cleanup drill only inside a newly created owned filesystem sandbox.
notes: Sandbox-drill-only. Existing roots, symlink parents, live targets, Recovery Center, permission checks, production state, retained drill files, promotion, and CANON are refused. Browser mode prepares a request; Node executes the real filesystem drill.
